scope: Strict Data Stream post-list response contract, explicit public report projections, and REST SDK envelope/location binding

checks.ruff: passed for changed Python source and tests
checks.python_compile: passed for changed Python source and tests

contracts.data_stream_post_list: The private Gateway list validates its exact OpenAPI response projection, bounded records, enum/value shape, and requested location. Malformed, extra, or cross-location rows fail as a sanitized no-store 500; authorization, SQL, page bounds, and payload fields remain unchanged.
contracts.public_report_projections: Replication readiness selects 19, adaptive stewardship 19, and capital alignment 17 current public-view columns explicitly. Existing filters, binds, ordering, aggregates, shared null-location replication rows, and serialized payloads are covered by regressions.
contracts.public_rest_sdks: Python and TypeScript require success envelopes to contain exactly `data`; location detail results must match the requested UUID after case normalization. Existing path encoding and SDK error types are retained.

content_review: These checks establish source-level response, projection, and SDK parity contracts; they do not establish content-level privacy or populated-data parity.
